en.about: Parallel Passages Editor is a Paratext tool that hides books, chapters or passages from Paratext's Parallel Passages tool, for example 1 and 2 Chronicles, so their many parallels with Samuel and Kings are not listed. You can also add parallel passages of your own. It edits Paratext's own ParallelPassages.xml, keeps the original file, and saves your lists so they can be put back after a Paratext update. Windows asks for administrator permission when it opens, because the file is in the Program Files folder. The changes apply to every project on the computer; restart Paratext after saving.

en.title: Parallel Passages Editor
en.sub: A Paratext tool: hide books or chapters, and add your own parallel passages
en.text: Parallel Passages Editor is a Paratext tool. It hides the books or chapters you don't want listed in Paratext's Parallel Passages tool, and lets you add passages of your own.

en.title: Open it from the Tools menu
en.q: How do I open Parallel Passages Editor?
en.text: In Paratext, choose {0}Tools, then {1}Parallel Passages Editor. Windows asks for administrator permission, because Paratext keeps this file in the Program Files folder.

en.title: Paratext's list of parallel passages
en.text: {0}The editor opens Paratext's own list of parallel passages. {1}It is shared by every project on this computer. {2}Books, chapters and the entries of what you select are listed side by side. {3}The status bar counts the hidden entries.

en.title: Choose a book
en.q: How do I see a book's parallels?
en.text: {0}Click a book, here 1 Chronicles. {1}Its chapters are listed, {2}with each parallel passage and the verses it goes with.

en.title: Hide whole books
en.q: How do I hide a book?
en.text: {0}Chronicles has many parallels with Samuel and Kings. To hide both books, select them, {1}and click Hide book. You can also tick a book's box. {2}The count of hidden entries goes up.

en.title: Passages hidden with them
en.q: What happens to the other verses of a passage?
en.text: {0}In 2 Samuel, some passages had only one other verse, in Chronicles. {1}A passage needs at least two visible verses, so these are hidden too, and the note says why. {2}The status bar counts them.

en.title: Hide a chapter
en.q: Can I hide only a chapter?
en.text: {0}Chapters work the same way. Select one or more, here Psalm 18, which is also 2 Samuel 22, {1}and click Hide chapters, or tick a chapter's box. {2}Its entries are now hidden.

en.title: Add a passage of your own
en.q: Can I add my own parallel passages?
en.text: You can also add parallel passages that Paratext's list does not have. {0}Click Add passage.

en.title: Type the references
en.q: How do I type a new passage?
en.text: {0}Type the references one per line, at least two, in the Original versification. {1}Here, John 3:16 and 1 John 4:9, where God sends his only Son. The editor checks that each verse exists. {2}Click OK.

en.title: Added by you
en.q: How do I change or remove a passage I added?
en.text: {0}The new passage is listed with its verses, {1}marked Added by you. Paratext cannot highlight its words, as it does for its own passages. {2}Only passages you added can be edited or removed.

en.title: A list for this project
en.q: Can a project keep its own list?
en.text: {0}Tick this box to keep the list with this project too. When you later open the editor from the project, it offers to use that list again.

en.title: Save
en.q: How do I save the changes?

en.title: Saved
en.text: {0}The first time you save, the original file is kept beside it, as ParallelPassages.xmlorg. {1}Restart Paratext for the changes to take effect.

en.title: After a Paratext update
en.q: What happens after a Paratext update?
en.text: {0}A Paratext update can put the original file back. The editor then offers to add your own passages again. {1}Click Yes.

en.title: Your hidden list
en.q: Can I hide the same books again after an update?
en.text: {0}It also remembers what you hid last time, and offers to hide it again. {1}Click Yes. The File menu has both commands too.

en.title: Hidden again
en.text: {0}The books and chapters are hidden again. {1}Save, and restart Paratext.

en.title: Installing the tool
en.q: How do I install the tool?

en.title: Ready to use
en.text: Start Paratext again. {1,0}Parallel Passages Editor is now on the Tools menu.

en.title: Parallel Passages Editor
en.sub: Hide books or chapters  ·  Add your own passages  ·  Reapply after an update
en.text: Parallel Passages Editor hides the books and chapters you choose from Paratext's Parallel Passages tool, adds your own passages, keeps the original file, and puts your lists back after an update.
